references.text: Jesus' deliberate choice to leave Judea and return to Galilee, a pattern repeated in 7:9.
An early reference to Jesus staying in Galilee with his mother and disciples, establishing a geographical context.
Description of Jesus crossing to the other side of the Sea of Galilee, confirming his presence in the region.
Jesus withdraws to a place near the wilderness to avoid conflict, a similar pattern of leaving Judea to remain safe.
